_comment: Vestigial: inherited from the OneFlow Jekyll theme. Nothing installs from it (no lockfile, no node_modules, and _config.yml excludes it from the build), and 'add-banner' calls a banner.js that is not in this repo. It is kept for the 'uglify' recipe, which documents how assets/js/main.min.js was produced. 'name' is what port-watching dev tools (localdock) label this repo's dev server with, and the only one it starts is the admin app demo on :8080 - hence training-app-demo rather than the repository name. The theme's attribution lives in README.md and LICENSE-theme.txt, not here.
name: training-app-demo
description: arc42 trainings site — Jekyll sources and the trainings admin app
author: arc42 (Gernot Starke)

scripts.uglify: uglifyjs assets/js/vendor/jquery/jquery-3.6.0.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.fitvids.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.greedy-navigation.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.magnific-popup.js assets/js/plugins/jquery.ba-throttle-debounce.js assets/js/plugins/smooth-scroll.js assets/js/plugins/gumshoe.js assets/js/_main.js -c -m -o assets/js/main.min.js
scripts.build:js: npm run uglify && npm run add-banner
